judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A pleasant mountain sky with bold cumulus and rich blue, but the flat daylight and dominant foreground keep it from being more striking.
strengths: large billowing cumulus with good structure
weaknesses: foreground meadow takes up much of the frame
some bright cloud areas look slightly clipped
